description: Searches for an H_A(q) element with ordinary Jones–Markov trace equal to [A]_q at q_0, for A=2..4. Reports negative result for natural candidates and confirms the U_q(sl_A) qdim identification as the primary categorical home.

candidates.rationale: Markov property tr_M(σ_n · w) = z · tr_M(w)
chain Markov: tr_M(σ_1 σ_2) = z·tr_M(σ_1) = z²

candidates.element: σ_1 σ_2 σ_3 (long crossing in H_4)

verdict: [A]_q is identified as qdim_q(V_A) in U_q(sl_A) via Schur–Weyl duality. A natural element-level Markov-trace identity in H_A(q) directly does NOT yield [A]_q under standard Jones–Markov normalisation; the U_q(sl_A) qdim is the clean categorical home.
